scientific_non_regression.p10_p90_semantics: pointwise structural sensitivity; not confidence interval; not future probability

peak.definition: first global maximum of the selected scenario series

collapse_window.label_rule: do not emit 'collapse window' unless the primary severe-decline quorum is satisfied

scenario_alignment.evaluation_period: years with both observation and scenario value
not: out-of-sample forecast skill unless separately demonstrated

event_timing_uncertainty.reason: pointwise quantile/envelope series are not coherent ensemble trajectories and do not identify a distribution of event times
event_timing_uncertainty.required_for_timing_interval: versioned coherent ensemble trajectories or an explicitly calibrated event-time distribution

product_surface.primary_user_question: What trajectories does World3 indicate, when do important changes occur, how robust are they, and what difference do alternative scenarios make?

intervention_gate.reason: No intervention operator or authoritative intervention trajectory package has passed the scientific promotion gates.
intervention_gate.preparedness_semantics: external resilience domains; not country policy prescriptions produced by World3

usefulness_gate: new user can explain what World3 is
new user can distinguish BAU, BAU2 and BAU Hybrid 2026
new user can explain observations versus scenarios
new user can find principal peaks and sustained-decline onsets without README
new user can see what timing uncertainty is and is not identified
new user can identify the model mechanism associated with the selected variable
new user can see which intervention results are scientifically available and which are not
new user can determine whether intervention timing is currently quantifiable
new user can state the interpretation limits
